_comment: Other groups using the kids pool. Each block repeats weekly on 'weekday' between 'start' and 'end' (inclusive), skipping BS school holidays if 'skip_school_holidays' is true. Use 'dates' instead of weekday/start/end for one-off dates. Example: {"label": "Schulschwimmen", "weekday": "tue", "time": ["08:00", "10:00"], "start": "2026-09-01", "end": "2027-06-30", "skip_school_holidays": true, "exclude": ["2027-01-05"]}
